images.alt: Title slide reading "5 tips to magnetize 200 minis in 20 minutes" over a storage box of unpainted red and teal Marvel United minis
Tip 1, the baking sheet method: hands pressing parchment paper onto an upturned baking sheet on a green cutting mat, paint rack behind
Tip 2, work in batches: painted minis pressed onto hot glue blobs on the parchment, a hot glue gun in hand
Tip 3, scooch uneven or hollow bases: two hands sliding an unpainted mini forward on the parchment so the glue grips
Tip 4, fill extra space with more glue: fingers holding a mini with a hollow pink base over the baking sheet
Tip 5, magnetic receptive rubber sheets: a hand peeling a flexible grey self-adhesive sheet off a stack
End slide pointing to the full YouTube tutorial, with a "Magnetize 200 minis in 20 minutes" thumbnail beside a box of red minis
